bison-1.author: Base Labs

cost.basis: Baseten Model APIs launch list price, USD 0.1/M input with free output (https://www.baseten.co/library/bison-1/, read 21 Nov 2026). Counted under the frozen I-1 launch-list-price rule, excluding promotional credits. This is above the google/gemma-4-31b-it base-model reference, USD 0.09/M input and USD 0.34/M output from the frozen OpenRouter snapshot, so the list price counts. The API reported one output token per item; output is free. The common 1,489-item basis uses 571,160 measured input tokens and yields USD 0.0383586299529886 per 1,000 decisions. The full 1,500-item run used 972,512 input tokens and yields USD 0.0648341333333333 per 1,000 decisions.

bison-1.disclosure: Hosted API via Baseten Model APIs, served as decision-models/baseten-bison-31b-latest (a -latest alias), measured 21 Nov 2026; not tied to a Hugging Face revision. Reference Hugging Face HEAD at run time: baselabs/bison-1@bf8350b2. Baseten documentation lists 131,072 context tokens, while its management API reported 32,768. Five items of 77–82k input tokens received answers with full reported usage; reported usage is not proof that every token was read. Failed or unanswered requests count as wrong answers. Baseten retention statements are vendor claims and were not audited.

cost.basis: Baseten Model APIs launch list price, USD 0.035/M input with free output (https://www.baseten.co/library/groundhog-1/, read 21 Nov 2026). Counted under the frozen I-1 launch-list-price rule, excluding promotional credits. This is below the google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it base-model reference, USD 0.09/M input and USD 0.3/M output from the frozen OpenRouter snapshot, so the M2 §2 floor binds (price floor: base-model reference price applied). The full 1,500-item run used 972,512 input tokens and yields USD 0.05865072 per 1,000 decisions.
